html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

This summer, two heroes have arrived at the beach, 
bringing the heat of the blazing sun and the essence of the sandy shores. 


A New Uniform has been added for Jean Grey, 
the Omega-level mutant and avatar of the cosmic entity, the Phoenix Force. 
Additionally, Sandman, who boasts superhuman durability 
and versatile combat skills using his sand-shifting body,
has received a New Uniform and his Tier-4 Advancement.

 

Agents, please download the 7/7 (Tue) patch 
to check out their new skills and enhanced power!


■ 7/7 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 7/8 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 7/7 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[7/8 (Wed) 2:44 (UTC+0), 7/7 (Tue) 19:44 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 7/8 (Wed) 2:43 (UTC+0), 7/7 (Tue) 19:43 (PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ Two New Uniforms


Two new Uniforms, Jean Grey <Summer Flare Phoenix>, 
and Sandman <Beach Fortress> have been added.
* The two new Uniforms can be purchased after the 7/7 Patch data has been applied.
* New Uniforms are available for purchase during the Event period.
* Seasonal Uniforms may be available for purchase again 
after the event has been over through similar events or packages.
* A 10% Agent Supplies discount coupon will be distributed in celebration of Summer 2026.
- Coupon acquisition and available period: 
7/7 (Tue) 15:00 – 7/21 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
7/7 (Tue) 8:00 – 7/21 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)


▶ Jean Grey <Summer Flare Phoenix>
After the 7/8 Patch - 7/24 (Fri) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 7/7 Patch - 7/24 (Fri) 7:59 (PDT)
- How to Purchase: Exchange for 2026 Summer Token Shop Tokens in the Event Token Shop
- 2026 Summer Token Shop Tokens can be acquired until 7/21 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0) / 7:59 (PDT) through purchasing Event Products sold in-game and at the Agent Supplies and through other methods.
* Please check if the token is included before purchasing any product. 


▶ You can also obtain 2026 Summer Token Shop Tokens from the Agent Supplies products,
and products that can grant these tokens are marked in the upper-right corner.

 

 

Sale Period:
7/7 (Tue) 15:00 - 7/21 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0)
7/7 (Tue) 8:00 - 7/21 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
Please visit the Agent Supplies during this period to check them out.
[Go to Agent Supplies]


▶ Sandman <Beach Fortress>
After the 7/8 Patch - 7/21 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 7/7 Patch - 7/21 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- How to Purchase: Crystal purchase (Discount event will not be applied.)
 
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ Sandman Tier-4  

 

Tier-4 Advancement is now available for Sandman.
Combined with his boundless shapeshifting abilities, 
his presence on the battlefield can truly be described as a natural disaster.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes


1. Shadowland: Fixed an issue in Challenge Mode Floor 11 where taking hits from the rotating blades dealt abnormally high damage.


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
